subject: Re: Proposal: staggered platform-fee + support-tier swap for pilot -> prod
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@hearthstonehealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@hearthstonehealth.com, j.li@hearthstonehealth.com
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: pilot billing cadence and platform fee offset

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team is excited by latency numbers and the cost-savings potential. Before we hand the technical PoC to procurement, two commercial questions came up from our CFO and procurement team:

1) Our budget needs platform fees amortized over a 12-month pilot -> production ramp. Can you do a staggered platform fee (50% pilot, then monthly amortization over 12 months) instead of full upfront?

2) We have an internal SRE retainer for on-call. Is there a way to swap some of the platform fee for a higher support tier during the pilot (faster SLAs) and then revert once in prod? Essentially a platform-fee offset in exchange for temporary SRE coverage.

We expect pilot to run 3 months, then production in month 4 if metrics hit the SLA. Procurement asked for a short note of feasibility and any required contract language so they can start redlines.

Attachments: their internal runbook (we'll share on Drive).

Appreciate a quick read — can you circle back by tomorrow?

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Hearthstone Health

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@hearthstonehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: pilot billing cadence and platform fee offset

Aisha — thanks for laying out the ask. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate both, with a few guardrails. Summary proposal below and I've attached a revised quote (HS-quote-v2.pdf) and a draft SOW for procurement to review.

Option A (Pilot-friendly, low up-front):
- Platform fee: 50% invoiced at pilot kickoff, remaining 50% amortized over 10 months post-pilot (starts month 4).
- Support: included "Pilot SRE" tier (faster response windows, 2-hr P1 during pilot) rolled into platform-fee discount (we'd attribute 25% of the platform fee value to the SRE coverage for pilot months).
- Commitment: 3-month pilot minimum; production conversion triggers the amortization schedule.

Option B (Balanced):
- Platform fee: no amortization, but 20% pilot discount if Hearthstone commits to a 12-month conversion within 90 days of pilot end.
- Support: you pay for higher SRE coverage during pilot as a time-limited retainer (credited back at conversion).

Key commercial notes:
- We need an explicit conversion clause (pilot -> production) to avoid indefinite pilot discount exposure.
- Amortization requires a signed commercial addendum and monthly invoicing schedule.
- Any support swap must be timebound to the pilot window and documented in the SOW.

I've cc'd Irene so legal can confirm the correct addendum language and any billing implications for amortization (revenue recognition / tax). If this looks acceptable, I'll ask sales ops to prepare an invoice schedule and update the quote.

Attachments: HS-quote-v2.pdf, SOW-draft-hearthstone.docx

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Solutions & Commercial Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@hearthstonehealth.com>

Aisha — quick follow up from GTM side. CFO asked if we can also include a one-time implementation credit for runbook integration (worth one week of dedicated engineering), to help with initial observability configuration. We can fund this from the pilot discount bucket if you confirm it's used during pilot months.

If you're good with Option A + implementation credit, we'll:
- Lock pilot start date and invoice 50% platform fee at kickoff.
- Add a pilot SOW appendix that lists the 2-hr P1 SLA and the implementation week.
- Send conversion addendum template for procurement's redlines (Irene, please weigh in).

Quick yes/no from Hearthstone and we'll push to billing/legal ops.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@hearthstonehealth.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: pilot billing cadence and platform fee offset

Hi all — legal and finance reviewed Option A and suggested language. High-level items we will require in the addendum / SOW: 

1) Conversion trigger: a mutually agreed "go/no-go" checklist (metrics + date) signed by both parties. Conversion triggers amortization schedule to begin in month 4.
2) Refund / clawback: if Hearthstone elects not to convert after pilot, the amortized portion remains unpaid; we will not issue refunds for amortized months already billed. If Redwood terminates for cause, we will prorate remaining amortization.
3) Support swap mechanics: define exact coverage hours, escalation path, and handoff plan in SOW appendix A; the platform fee credit applied to support is non-transferable and expires at pilot end.
4) Billing & tax note: amortized invoices will be monthly with net30; finance needs a billing contact for ACH. Also confirm whether Hearthstone requires invoices to reference a PO number.

I'll attach the addendum template in the next email. From a risk perspective this structure is standardable across other pilots, but please confirm internally if finance is comfortable with monthly amortization starting post-pilot.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

On procurement details: procurement@hearthstonehealth.com — please confirm preferred PO / billing flow so ops can set up the invoice template.
